files..env.example:
# Environment of the API. Export these variables before running it. Never commit real values.

# Port the API listens on
PORT=8080

# Database connection
DATABASE_URL=postgres://api:change-me@localhost:5432/api

# Secret that signs the tokens of your identity provider (at least 32 bytes). Without it every protected request is rejected.
JWT_SECRET=
# Optional: expected audience and issuer of the tokens
JWT_AUDIENCE=
JWT_ISSUER=

        genre:

                - not_implemented
                - method_not_allowed
                - internal_error
            message:

            details:

                properties:

files.README.md:
# library-api

REST API generated by [Model2API](https://raulesteveza.github.io/tools/Model2API/) with Axum. It is a starting point: review it before using it in production.

## Run it

Requires Rust 1.99 or later.

```bash
cargo run
```

Set the variables of `.env.example` in your environment first. The API listens on http://localhost:8080. Its contract is in `openapi.yaml`.

## Test it

```bash
cargo test
```

Each test builds the application anew, so it starts with empty storage.
The tests use a new SQLite file for each test, or the postgresql database in `TEST_DATABASE_URL` (its tables are dropped before each test, and the tests take turns).

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | What it does | Success | Access |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/authors` | List authors | 200 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/authors/{id}` | Get an author | 200 | authenticated |
| `POST` | `/authors` | Create an author | 201 | authenticated |
| `PUT` | `/authors/{id}` | Replace an author | 200 | authenticated |
| `PATCH` | `/authors/{id}` | Update part of an author | 200 | authenticated |
| `DELETE` | `/authors/{id}` | Delete an author | 204 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/books` | List books | 200 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/books/{id}` | Get a book | 200 | authenticated |
| `POST` | `/books` | Create a book | 201 | authenticated |
| `PUT` | `/books/{id}` | Replace a book | 200 | authenticated |
| `PATCH` | `/books/{id}` | Update part of a book | 200 | authenticated |
| `DELETE` | `/books/{id}` | Delete a book | 204 | authenticated |

Errors always have the same body: `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": [...]}}`. Invalid requests answer 400.

## Storage

SeaORM on postgresql. The application creates the tables that are missing when it starts, while you develop; for a real database, use migrations (Model2DB writes them). Embedded objects and lists are stored as JSON text, and references as key columns.

## Authentication

Protected endpoints need a bearer token issued by your identity provider, signed with HS256. The API verifies it with `JWT_SECRET` (and `JWT_AUDIENCE` / `JWT_ISSUER` when set), requires an expiry, and reads the roles from the `roles` claim. It does not issue tokens.

## Structure

```text
src/
  main.rs               entry point: reads the settings and serves the API
  lib.rs                state and router: wires storage, services and routes
  common/               errors, request bodies, lists, query strings and settings
  models/               domain types, enums and embedded objects
  dtos/                 request bodies and responses
  repositories/         storage
  entities/             tables, as SeaORM entities
  services/             rules of each resource
  routes/               HTTP routes
  database.rs           connection and tables
  security.rs           authentication
tests/api/               one test module per resource
openapi.yaml             the contract of the API
```

## Left to you

- Nothing marked: review the generated code before using it.
